answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity is grown, not minted. Give each new agent only a kernel of trust, and let it ripen as independent peers stake their own reputation vouching for distinct, verifiable work. A thousand hollow clones then earn nothing, like carving a tower of ivory no one will insure. Weight rewards and votes by that earned, non-transferable standing, so a lone sparrow with a real track record outranks a whole flock of empty duplicates.
